question: Using Guidewire's fiscal 2026 Form 10-K and its fiscal Q3 2026 Form 10-Q, what were the implied fiscal Q4 2026 (three months ended July 31, 2026) total revenue and GAAP operating margin?
grading: Computation: Q4 = FY2026 - nine months ended April 30, 2026. Revenue USD 411.1M (411,087K); GAAP income from operations USD 62.3M (62,318K); GAAP operating margin 15.16% (+/-0.3pp). Accept +/-0.5% on dollar figures. Fail if non-GAAP operating income (USD 111.3M, 27.1%) is used as the GAAP margin.
answer: Implied Q4 FY2026 revenue = 1,475,363 (FY2026) - 1,064,276 (nine months to April 30, 2026) = USD 411,087 thousand (USD 411.1 million). Implied GAAP income from operations = 149,874 - 87,556 = USD 62,318 thousand (USD 62.3 million). GAAP operating margin = 62,318 / 411,087 = 15.16% [H11-E1][H11-E2]. This matches the Q4 figures in the earnings release (revenue USD 411.1 million; GAAP income from operations USD 62.3 million) [H11-E3].

output.answer:
## Implied Fiscal Q4 2026 (three months ended July 31, 2026)

| Metric | FY2026 (full year) | Less: 9M ended Apr 30, 2026 (10-Q) | = Implied Q4 (3M ended Jul 31, 2026) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Total revenue | $1,475.4M | $1,064.3M | **≈ $411.1M** |
| GAAP income from operations | $149.9M | $87.6M | **≈ $62.3M** |
| GAAP operating margin | 10.2% | 8.2% | **≈ 15.2%** |

### How the numbers tie out
- **FY2026 10-K / Q4 release:** total revenue for fiscal year 2026 was **$1,475.4M**, and GAAP income from operations was **$149.9M** (vs. $41.1M in FY2025). ([Guidewire Q4/FY26 release](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/guidewire-announces-fourth-quarter-fiscal-200500304.html); [FY26 8-K](https://ir.guidewire.com/static-files/66e8e995-2454-4523-87c3-df1e03e539f9))
- **Q3 FY2026 10-Q (nine months ended April 30, 2026):** total revenue **$1,064.276M** and GAAP income from operations **$87.556M**. ([GWRE 10-Q, gwre-20260430](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1528396/000152839626000027/gwre-20260430.htm); [Q3 FY26 release](https://ir.guidewire.com/news-releases/news-release-details/guidewire-announces-third-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-financial))

### Implied Q4 FY2026
- **Total revenue:** $1,475.4M − $1,064.3M = **≈ $411.1M** (up ~15% YoY from $356.6M in Q4 FY2025)
- **GAAP operating income:** $149.9M − $87.6M = **≈ $62.3M**
- **GAAP operating margin:** $62.3M ÷ $411.1M = **≈ 15.2%**

Notably, this implied Q4 margin (~15%) is well above both the 9-month run-rate (8.2%) and the full-year level (10.2%), reflecting the strong Q4 profitability Guidewire reported. The implied figures also line up with the directly reported Q4 revenue of ~$411.1M, confirming the arithmetic.

*Caveat:* These are derived from the annual (10-K) minus year-to-date (10-Q) figures rather than a separately stated Q4 income statement; small rounding differences may exist.
